## What an agent can do here

{{SITE_NAME}} exposes a small, read-only public surface. No authentication is required for the endpoints listed below, and they return only aggregate, non-personal data. A machine-readable description of this surface is published as an OpenAPI document.

- [OpenAPI description]({{SITE_URL}}/openapi.yaml): Machine-readable spec for {{SITE_NAME}}'s public, read-only endpoints.
- [{{ENDPOINT_SUMMARY}} (JSON)]({{SITE_URL}}{{ENDPOINT_PATH}}): {{ENDPOINT_DESCRIPTION}}

## MCP endpoint (for agents)

{{SITE_NAME}} serves a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposing:

- `{{TOOL_NAME}}` (free) — {{TOOL_DESCRIPTION}}

Run it locally over stdio (see `mcp/README.md`), or host it over Streamable HTTP and advertise the URL here once it is live.
